findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_app_icon_set, build_app_store_link, calculate_app_store_net_revenue, appstore_compare_markets, image_compression_curve, strip_image_metadata, inspect_mobileprovision, check_strings_files, convert_video_to_gif · Private data: estimate_ai_tokens, generate_app_icon_set, image_compress, image_compression_curve, strip_image_metadata, generate_favicon_set, convert_heic_to_jpg_png, inspect_mobileprovision, plant_watering_calendar, build_app_privacy_label, resize_images, check_strings_files, convert_video_to_gif · Public sink: calculate_app_store_net_revenue, build_app_privacy_label, render_app_store_screenshot, convert_video_to_gif · Destructive: appstore_compare_markets, bpm_delay_calculator, image_compress, generate_favicon_set, convert_heic_to_jpg_png, render_app_store_screenshot, check_strings_files, convert_video_to_gif.
